description.value: You learn two Techniques of your choice from the Mechanic's shared list, each of which is fueled by rolling your Tech Die rather than expending a power die. Your Tech Die is a d4 at 1st rank, increasing to a d6 at 2nd rank, a d8 at 3rd rank, a d10 at 4th rank, and a d12 at 5th rank. You learn an additional Technique at each Mechanic rank thereafter, to a maximum of five known Techniques at 5th rank. Whenever you roll a 1 on your Tech Die, it shrinks by one size until the end of your next turn; whenever you roll its maximum value, it grows by one size (to a maximum of d12) and you may roll an extra Tech Die and choose the result, both until the end of your next turn.
